title: Akum language
text: Akum is a Southern Jukunoid language (ISO 639-3: aku) belonging to the Benue-Congo branch of the Niger-Congo family, spoken by approximately 1,400 people (2021) within an ethnic community of up to 7,000 (2002) across five villages in the Cameroon-Nigeria border region.
